limitations: Core inventory entries retain their previous dispositions. The 22-entry source snapshot is an audit record, not certification of all senses or attachment classes.

Finite restriction applies to canonical 으려고 followed by auxiliary 하다/들다 with its own ending 는다/다/어요/습니다. Only the immediately preceding owner is constrained; right-hand and earlier tense are retained.
No new lexical adjective conflict is assigned. Asymmetric long-allomorph notes, state-making/coercive readings and related shortened-expression notes need resolution before broader filtering.
The four preserved source-conflicted expansions are hypotheses, not required grammaticality judgments. Standalone 먹겠으려고 and unreviewed auxiliary endpoints remain open.

The derived rhetorical path is a source-pattern regression, not a newly recovered annotated gold token. No matching fused forms were found in the scanned KAIST/GSD training data; the frozen source corpora and previous training fixtures are compared unchanged.
Independent Korean-language review remains pending; source-backed authored judgments and dictionary headword matches do not measure precision.

release_performance.method: Three interleaved release CLI runs per version/filter, including startup, dictionary access and JSONL serialization; stdout discarded. Linux per-child peak RSS. Measurements do not establish statistical equivalence.
